# Growrix OS

> Growrix OS is a founder-led product studio and digital marketplace. It sells
> production-ready website templates, HTML business profiles, SaaS starters and
> AI toolkits, and it delivers custom website, SaaS, mobile app, automation,
> technical SEO and AI business system projects for clients.

Growrix OS is the brand operating at https://www.growrixos.com. It is not a
system identifier, a file format, or a product of any other agency. Two delivery
tracks run side by side: self-serve digital products you buy and download, and
done-for-you client projects scoped through a call.

## Start here

- [Home](https://www.growrixos.com/): What Growrix OS does, in one page.
- [About](https://www.growrixos.com/about): Who runs the studio and how it works.

## Services (done-for-you)

- [All services](https://www.growrixos.com/services)
- [Websites](https://www.growrixos.com/services/websites): Marketing sites and business websites.
- [SaaS applications](https://www.growrixos.com/services/saas-applications): Multi-tenant products, billing, dashboards.
- [Mobile apps](https://www.growrixos.com/services/mobile-apps): iOS and Android builds.
- [AI business systems](https://www.growrixos.com/services/ai-business-systems): Assistants and AI workflows wired into a business.
- [Automation](https://www.growrixos.com/services/automation): Internal workflow and integration automation.
- [Technical SEO](https://www.growrixos.com/services/technical-seo): Crawlability, indexing, Core Web Vitals, structured data.
- [Additional services](https://www.growrixos.com/additional-services): Smaller scoped engagements.
